sentences.text: PROCEEDING SHEET Sl.No DATE OFFICE  ORDER NOTE 1. 08.11.2024 VS, J I.A.No.1 of 2024 Dispensed with for the present.
On perusal of the charge-sheet, it can be seen that except omnibus allegations, there are no specific allegations as against accused Nos.2 to 6 i.e. petitioner Nos.2 to 6 herein.

In view of the same, there shall be interim stay of all further proceedings in C.C.No.4318 of 2023,
dated 15.11.2023 on the file of IV Additional Junior Civil Judge, Guntur filed under Section 498A of IPC and Section 3 and 4 of D.P.Act, as against the petitioner Nos.2, 3, 4, 5 and 6/accused Nos. 2, 3,
4, 5 and 6 only.
The trial against accused No.1 may go on.

Learned counsel for the petitioners is permitted to take out personal notice to respondent No.2 by registered post with acknowledgement due and file proof of service into the Registry within ten days.
Post the matter after four (4) weeks.
